state_queries.scheduled: SELECT count(*) FROM awa.deferred_jobs WHERE state = 'scheduled'
state_queries.retryable: SELECT count(*) FROM awa.deferred_jobs WHERE state = 'retryable'
state_queries.dead: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM awa.done_entries WHERE state = 'failed') + (SELECT count(*) FROM awa.dlq_entries)
state_queries.running: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM awa.leases WHERE state = 'running') + (SELECT count(*) FROM awa.lease_claims c WHERE c.closed_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awa.lease_claim_closures x WHERE x.claim_slot = c.claim_slot AND x.job_id = c.job_id AND x.run_lease = c.run_lease) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awa.lease_claim_closure_batches b WHERE b.claim_slot = c.claim_slot AND b.receipt_ranges @> c.receipt_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awa.done_entries d WHERE d.job_id = c.job_id AND d.run_lease = c.run_lease) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awa.deferred_jobs d WHERE d.job_id = c.job_id AND d.run_lease = c.run_lease) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awa.dlq_entries d WHERE d.job_id = c.job_id AND d.run_lease = c.run_lease) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awa.leases l WHERE l.job_id = c.job_id AND l.run_lease = c.run_lease))
